question:
Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, and Gertrude are on the same team in a soccer match. At the start of the match, they are each assigned to a position: Alice is playing cheerleader, Bob is playing goalkeeper, Claire is playing right back, Dave is playing left back, Eve is playing sweeper, Fred is playing fullback, and Gertrude is playing left winger.
As the game progresses, pairs of players occasionally swap positions. First, Alice and Eve trade positions. Then, Dave and Fred trade positions. Then, Bob and Dave trade positions. Then, Bob and Claire trade positions. Then, Eve and Fred trade positions. Then, Fred and Gertrude trade positions. Finally, Gertrude and Bob trade positions. At the end of the match, Dave is playing
Options:
(A) cheerleader
(B) goalkeeper
(C) right back
(D) left back
(E) sweeper
(F) fullback
(G) left winger
solution:
Each row lists positions in this order: Alice, Bob, Claire, Dave, Eve, Fred, Gertrude.
Initial: cheerleader, goalkeeper, right back, left back, sweeper, fullback, left winger
1. Alice–Eve: sweeper, goalkeeper, right back, left back, cheerleader, fullback, left winger
2. Dave–Fred: sweeper, goalkeeper, right back, fullback, cheerleader, left back, left winger
3. Bob–Dave: sweeper, fullback, right back, goalkeeper, cheerleader, left back, left winger
4. Bob–Claire: sweeper, right back, fullback, goalkeeper, cheerleader, left back, left winger
5. Eve–Fred: sweeper, right back, fullback, goalkeeper, left back, cheerleader, left winger
6. Fred–Gertrude: sweeper, right back, fullback, goalkeeper, left back, left winger, cheerleader
7. Gertrude–Bob: sweeper, cheerleader, fullback, goalkeeper, left back, left winger, right back
Dave is playing goalkeeper, option (B).
Final answer: (B)
